about: The sights ForgeVisual ships, self-made in Blender on 11-06 (Assets/Sights/LICENSE.txt): each model is Assets/Sights/<id>.model.json (Forge model package descriptor) with its local mesh <id>.forgemesh and textures <id>.t<index>.png. look is the point the eye lines up through (the reticle's centre), in the sight's own frame: Unity axes, front +Z, up +Y, origin at the middle of its base, metres at real size. magnification sets the aim field of view (gun-hold.json sight). A package puts a sight on a model with its forge-gun-sights table (GunSights).

red-dot-1x.about: Micro tube red dot on a riser and rail clamp with two cross bolts: 2.2 cm clear aperture, elevation and windage turrets, a brightness dial, a front flip cap swung open to the side, a 0.9 mm lit dot at the front lens.

holo-1x.about: Holographic sight: a chamfered tunnel hood with raked front and rear windows (2.7 x 2.2 cm), a side battery tube, three rear-deck buttons, a thumbscrew clamp, a lit 6 mm ring with a centre dot.

scope-2x.about: Compact 2x prism scope: objective bell, rounded prism body with a through bore, elevation and windage turrets, a rubber eyecup and focus ring; a lit chevron at the centre and no crosshair lines, a lit fibre strip on top.
